bias.label: Range 4,053-4,135; wait for CPI to pick a side

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Early gains fading
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,094 at 11:31 SAST, still up about 0.6% on the day but well off the 4,135 high hit earlier (Kitco).

bullets.title: Day range so far
bullets.text: Today's range is 4,053-4,135, so price is back in the middle near the 4,100 pivot (Kitco).

bullets.title: Dollar a bit weaker
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.9, down about 0.4%, and the US yield shown is near 4.87% (Trading Economics; tenor UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Oil still easing
bullets.text: Brent is near 97 and down on the day, which keeps inflation worries in check and helps gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets price about an 81% chance of a Fed hike by December, up from 71% before Friday's payrolls (FinanceFeeds, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: CPI is the test
bullets.text: October CPI lands Tuesday 15:30 SAST; FinanceFeeds frames it as a break toward 4,150 or back to 4,000.
